summary: Added `from __future__ import annotations` for modern typing support. Marked `PROVIDER_CHOICES` as `Final` to enforce immutability. Added comprehensive docstrings for all functions. Added URL validation for `mistral_api_url` and `groq_api_url` in `_apply_provider_overrides`. Enhanced input validation in `_csv_env` to handle `None` explicitly. Added type hints for `scan_dirs` in `main`.
